name: OpenGL Client State Array Rendering
aliases: OpenGL Rendering with Client State Arrays
definition: Methods to render pre-generated mesh data using OpenGL client state arrays for vertices, normals, and colors, supporting both indexed and non-indexed drawing.
summary: OpenGL Client State Array Rendering renders voxel meshes using legacy client-side memory pointers instead of GPU-resident Vertex Buffer Objects, making it simpler but slower than modern VBO-based approaches.
